SimulationRecord.title: SimulationRecord
SimulationRecord.description: Persisted disaster power negotiation simulation run owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who executed the simulation.

scenario.description: Name of the simulated disaster scenario.

totalDemand.description: Aggregate nominal power demand across all 4 critical services in MW.

safe.description: Whether all critical services received at least their minimum safe power.

statusMessage.description: Outcome summary from the negotiation engine.

hospitalAllocated.description: Power allocated to Hospital in MW.

waterAllocated.description: Power allocated to Water Supply in MW.

emergencyAllocated.description: Power allocated to Emergency Services in MW.

telecomAllocated.description: Power allocated to Telecom Network in MW.

notes.description: Optional operator annotation for the simulation run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the simulation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the simulation record was last updated.

/simulations/{simulationId}.description: Stores user-owned disaster simulation runs and power allocation outcomes.
